name: 司潔妮
objective:
本課程旨在培養學生在商務情境中以英語參與會議與進行簡報的基礎能力。課程內容涵蓋會議常用語、簡報組織、意見表達、回應與提問等實用溝通技巧，幫助學生熟悉職場常見的英語溝通情境。透過情境對話、角色扮演、小組任務與簡短商務簡報等活動，學生將提升英語口語表達、自信與互動能力，並建立在商務會議與簡報場合中進行基本溝通的能力。
This course aims to develop their basic ability to participate in business meetings and give presentations in English. The course covers useful language and communication skills for workplace contexts, including meeting expressions, presentation organization, expressing opinions, responding to others, and asking questions. Through situational dialogues, role-plays, group tasks, and short business presentations, students will build confidence and improve their spoken English for effective communication in business meeting and presentation settings.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1 (9/10) Course Introduction & What Makes a Good Presenter
Week 2 (9/17) The Big Picture: Presentation Organizing
Week 3 (9/24) Knowing Your Audience
Week 4 (10/1) Organizing Your Content
Week 5 (10/8) Designing Slides That Work
Week 6 (10/15) Body Language and Voice
Week 7 (10/22) Opening and Closing Strong
Week 8 (10/29) Handling Questions 
Week 9 (11/5) From Presenting to Meeting: What Changes
Week 10 (11/12) Meeting Roles and Agenda
Week 11 (11/19) Joining a Discussion: Useful Phrases
Week 12 (11/26) Giving Opinions and Disagreeing Politely
Week 13 (12/3) Informative vs. Persuasive Speaking
Week 14 (12/10) Making Decisions Together 
Week 15 (12/17) Final Presentation (Day 1)
Week 16 (12/24) Final Presentation (Day 2) and Course Wrap-up
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Groups design an English dialogue on course themes, use AI (LLM) to draft a 4–5 page podcast script, and record + upload audio by end of class. Practices pronunciation / intonation and AI-assisted learning.

學生分組設計與課程內容主題相關的英文情境對話，運用 AI 工具 (LLM) 輔助撰寫 4-5 頁 A4 的 Podcast 節目講稿，並錄製完成之音檔於課堂結束前上傳指定平台。透過此任務學生實際練習英文發音與語調，並學習運用 AI 工具提升英文學習效果。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Wk17 (due Thu 12:00 noon): podcast planning document
Wk18 (due Thu 12:00 noon): audio recording + script.

第 17 週：小組 Podcast 節目設計，周四中午 12:00 前繳交節目規劃書。
第 18 週：小組 Podcast 節目錄音，周四中午 12:00 前繳交節目錄音檔與講稿。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Wk17–18: 20% of CP.

Week 17-18 作業合計占 課程成績 (CP) 20%。

This course is an English for Specific/Academic Purposes (ESP/EAP) course. All materials, handouts, and slides are in English. At least 80% of classroom instruction and teacher-student interaction is conducted in English.
